title: Treasure Hunt
hunt_started: The map marks a spot nearby. Search the circled area with a metal detector.
hunt_active: You are already following a treasure map.
too_far: You are too far from the treasure.
no_hunt: You have no active treasure map.
inv_full: Your pockets are full, some loot was left behind.
need_detector: Equip your metal detector to search the area.
pinpointed: Strong signal! Something is buried right here.
no_map: You no longer have the treasure map.
log_reopen_desc: Player re-opened their active treasure map.
log_spam_desc: Dig request inside the cooldown window.
log_nohunt_desc: Dig requested with no active treasure hunt (possible event trigger).
log_far_desc: Dig requested away from the treasure spot.
log_nomap_desc: Hunt was active but the treasure map was gone at dig time.
log_fast_desc: Payout requested without a full dig (possible callback trigger).
